goal: A profile leaves one Barkdown as a verified export and arrives in another as a new profile with its own database: notes, media, conversations, links and organization, without credentials.
scope: Export under the hold: a logical database dump, owned media and the profile files with a manifest
Import into a new profile: restore before first boot, navigation re-owned, credentials created on the importing side
The same from the app: Settings actions, progress, refusal reasons, interruption and resume
A second machine and another operating system when the Windows machine is back
acceptance: An export verifies against its manifest and carries no credential, owner key or machine-bound file
An import of that export serves the same Papers, revisions, blocks and media bytes on its own runtime and refuses the exporting runtime token
Navigation, conversations and drafts arrive owned by the importing library; the exported profile and the export folder are unchanged
An interrupted export or import leaves a journal that names its phase and can be resumed or discarded without touching an existing profile
A truncated, tampered or other-version export is refused before anything is created
nextAction: 1) When the Windows machine is back (about 2026-10-05): the return checkpoint, a real library, an export taken on one machine imported on the other, and the reclaim path on Windows. 2) Until then: decide with the user whether pre-existing cloud references get the managed owner at projection; Mac groundwork that does not depend on Windows. 3) Known and recorded, not chased: one drag step of the sidebar journey failed once and passed twice after.
truthReview: 2026-09-29: export and import are Settings actions, rehearsed in Electron on macOS with the imported profile opened. A host killed with SIGKILL is rehearsed three ways: idle (the runtime is reclaimed by its launch record), in the middle of an export (named, discarded, exported again) and in the middle of an import (listed, not selectable, imported again). Five refusals (tampered, truncated, added to, other version, not an export) are rehearsed from Settings and create nothing; an export folder opened in a file manager still imports. The library switch killed under the hold is resumed from the notice and completes; a kill while held with no operation in flight is reopened at launch. A writer whose connection is cut during a drain is not killed by it: the write completes and the hold is reached, so a writer that raises inside the runtime is not produced by any rehearsal. One stall point per operation; the folder picker and the system trash are stubbed in those rehearsals; the Windows reclaim path is written and not rehearsed; no second machine is claimed.
screenshotReview: Visual run 2026-09-29T14-55-15-425Z approved: 46 entries pixel-identical to the previous approved run. Notices and rows that the fixture tours do not reach were inspected in the live rehearsal screenshots.
